design_philosophy: A premium analytical tool that feels like a brand strategy deck or financial newspaper. Avoids generic SaaS soft-shadows. Embraces crisp 1px borders, rigid grids, editorial typography (Serif for insights, Mono for data, Sans for UI), and the warmth of the #F7F4EE paper background.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight text-primary leading-none
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl font-sans font-medium tracking-tight border-b-2 border-strong pb-2 mb-6

spacing_and_layout.strategy: The 'Control Room' Grid mixed with Editorial Whitespace
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Dashboard uses CSS Grid. Apply `gap-px bg-border_strong` on parent, and `bg-paper` on children to create literal 1px wireframe borders.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-none or max rounded-sm. NO large rounded corners.

score_ring.visual: Concentric SVG circles. Track is #E5E0D8. Progress uses dimension color. Center text is giant Mono font.

ai_insight_card.typography: Serif for insight body text. Mono for cited question IDs like [AW-3].

radar_chart.style: Recharts. Straight lines (not curved). Polygonal grid instead of circular. Fill opacity 0.1 with 2px solid stroke.

identity_image_connectors.layout: Two vertical lists (Intended vs Perceived). Center column is SVG canvas.
identity_image_connectors.paths: Cubic bezier curves. Aligned traits = solid 2px #10B981 path. Lost traits = dashed 1px #C8102E path.
identity_image_connectors.animation: Framer motion path drawing on scroll/reveal.

matrix_2x2.layout: CSS Grid or Recharts Scatter. 4 quadrants divided by 1px #1A1A1A lines.
matrix_2x2.dots: Target dot is 16px, dimension color, with a 2px offset outline (stroke) to pop out.

word_cloud.style: Align all words horizontally. Vary font-size and opacity. Target brand highlighted in primary brand color, bolded.

mobile_respondent.trait_grid: Bento-style CSS grid of tap targets. Selected state: inverted colors (bg-primary text-inverse) with scale down 0.98.
mobile_respondent.likert: Vertical stack of large buttons for mobile, NOT horizontal radio buttons which are hard to tap.

motion.page_transition: Fade in with slight 10px Y-axis translate.
motion.hover_card: No scale. Instead, use sharp shadow reveal: shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#1A1A1A] and -translate-y-[2px] -translate-x-[2px].
motion.ai_generation: Typewriter effect for insights. Scrambled text decode effect for the 'Status Indicator'.

signature_elements: Dotted rules: Use `border-dashed` or `border-dotted` for secondary separators.
Editorial numbers: Giant (text-8xl) font-serif text-border/30 absolute behind section headers (e.g., '01', '02').
Ink-stamps: Status tags (like 'ACTIVE', 'DRAFT') use border-2 border-primary text-primary font-mono text-xs uppercase px-2 py-1 rotate-[-2deg].

implementation_notes.css_scoping: Ensure all Tailwind overrides or custom classes are wrapped within `.be-root` to prevent bleeding into the SWU alumni module.
implementation_notes.framer_motion: Wrap grid items in `<motion.div>` directly, do not break grid parent-child relationship. Use `layout` prop for collapsible accordions.
